product: Authorize headless machines with the OAuth device code flow (Beta)
tagline: You can now get a workspace level OAuth token on a headless machine, such as a remote VM or container, by finishing sign in in a browser on another device.
what_it_does: You can now get a workspace level OAuth token on a headless machine, such as a remote VM or container, by finishing sign in in a browser on another device. Workspace admins can turn this on from the Previews page. Beta This feature is in Beta.
why_it_matters: ←✕ Security recommendations The user code and confirmation code grant access to your workspace.
